beats.text: Goosebumps from a song? Your brain is doing something wild.
Researchers scanned people while they listened to music that gave them chills.
At the peak, their brains released dopamine. The same reward chemical as food.
But here's the twist: dopamine also flowed before the peak. Just from waiting for it.
So that build-up before the drop? Your brain is paying you to wait.

sources: Salimpoor, Benovoy, Larcher, Dagher & Zatorre (2011). Anatomically distinct dopamine release during anticipation and experience of peak emotion to music. Nature Neuroscience 14. PET + fMRI; dopamine release in the striatum; caudate during anticipation, nucleus accumbens during the peak. Via Psychology Today.
